name: Invoices and other prescribed documents, for supplies to registered persons

attrs.quote: in respect of supply of goods or services or both to a registered person
attrs.scope: the notified class of registered persons
attrs.note: The class prepares invoice and other prescribed documents; FORM GST INV-01 names them (provision.in.ct-60-2020.document-types). From 1 January 2027, 04/2026 replaces this wording (provision.in.ct-04-2026.supplies).
